text: Forward error correction lets a link run at a pre-FEC bit error rate of 10^-3 to 10^-4 yet deliver 10^-15 post-FEC; a 20% soft-decision LDPC code provides a net coding ___ of about 9-10 dB.
explanation: Net coding gain measures how much the required SNR (or OSNR) is relaxed by the code; 20% SD-LDPC gives ~9-10 dB, versus ~6 dB for 7% hard-decision FEC. This gain is what lets systems operate close to the Shannon limit.
